texture_profile.scope: Simulation-only pre-edge event counters and an independent 64-line physical-address shadow cache. The shadow is reset each pass. It preserves word-granular validity within the active texture allocation and is an estimate of possible reuse across descriptor switches. It does not change simulated RTL execution.
texture_profile.runner:
"""Run simulation-only texture diagnostics against the existing board-core RTL model."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

RUN = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
LABEL = sys.argv[1]
TREE = RUN / ("baseline" if LABEL == "before" else "../worktree")
MODEL = TREE / "build/tang20k-core-sim"
OBJ = MODEL / "obj"
INCLUDE = RUN.parents[2] / ".deps/rtl/oss-cad-suite/share/verilator/include"
BUILD = json.loads((MODEL / "build-report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert BUILD["board_core_profile"] and not BUILD["cpp_device_backends_linked"]


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def verify():
    mismatches = [name for name, hash_value in BUILD["source_sha256"].items()
                  if sha(TREE / name) != hash_value]
    assert not mismatches, mismatches
    assert sha(TREE / "build/nano-gpu-tang20k-sim.exe") == BUILD["executable_sha256"]


verify()
original = TREE / "reference/rtl/main.cpp"
source = original.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def extend(old, new):
    global source
    assert source.count(old) == 1, old
    source = source.replace(old, new)


extend("namespace {\nusing namespace nano_gpu;", '#include "texture-refill-stats.hpp"\n\nnamespace {\nusing namespace nano_gpu;')
extend("    bool profiling = false;", "    bool profiling = false;\n    TextureRefillStats texture_stats;")
extend("        const bool pixel_tick = dut.video_pixel_ce;", """        const bool pixel_tick = dut.video_pixel_ce;
        if (profiling) texture_stats.sample(*dut.rootp, cycles);""")
extend("    const auto begin_case = [&] {", """    std::ofstream texture_report(std::string(stats) + ".texture.jsonl");
    if (!texture_report) throw std::runtime_error("Cannot open texture profile output");
    const auto begin_case = [&] {
        simulation.texture_stats = {};""")
extend("            const auto& r = simulation.raster_cycles;", """            simulation.texture_stats.print(texture_report, name, cycles, TEXTURE_RAM_WRITE_EDGES);
            const auto& r = simulation.raster_cycles;""")
generated = RUN / f"{LABEL}-profile-main.cpp"
generated.write_text(source, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
exe = RUN / f"{LABEL}-profile.exe"
objects = [OBJ / (name + ".o") for name in (
    "setup", "renderer", "demo", "hw_protocol", "sdram_model", "verilated",
    "verilated_dpi", "verilated_vcd_c", "verilated_threads",
)] + [OBJ / "Vnano_gpu_core__ALL.a"]
captured = {path.relative_to(MODEL).as_posix(): sha(path) for path in objects}
includes = [OBJ, INCLUDE, INCLUDE/"vltstd", TREE/"reference/include", TREE/"reference/rtl", RUN]
subprocess.run(["C:/msys64/ucrt64/bin/g++.exe", "-std=c++17", "-O2", "-pthread",
                "-DVL_TIME_CONTEXT=1", "-DNANO_GPU_ORACLE_ONLY=1", "-DNANO_GPU_BOARD_PROFILE=1",
                "-DVM_TRACE=1", "-DVM_TRACE_VCD=1", "-DVM_TRACE_FST=0",
                f"-DTEXTURE_RAM_WRITE_EDGES={2 if LABEL == 'before' else 1}",
                *(f"-I{path}" for path in includes), str(generated), *map(str, objects),
                "-o", str(exe)], cwd=TREE, check=True)
stats = RUN / f"{LABEL}-profile.json"
subprocess.run([str(exe), "--benchmark", "--profile", "--stats", str(stats)], cwd=TREE, check=True)
verify()
assert all(sha(MODEL / relative) == hash_value for relative, hash_value in captured.items())
(RUN / f"{LABEL}-profile-inputs.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "model_build_executable_sha256": BUILD["executable_sha256"],
    "instrumentation_header_sha256": sha(RUN / "texture-refill-stats.hpp"),
    "simulator_source_sha256": sha(original), "generated_source_sha256": sha(generated),
    "profiler_executable_sha256": sha(exe), "linked_object_sha256": captured,
}, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
